# Sorvel

> Sorvel (sorvel.agency) is a website design and development studio led by Mykola Tanasiichuk. It designs in Figma and builds marketing websites in Webflow, Framer and WordPress, and designs product UI. It works with businesses in every industry: SaaS, fintech, AI, e-commerce, real estate, healthcare, legal, travel, education and local services. Clients are worldwide; work is fully remote.

## Key facts

- Founder and design lead: Mykola Tanasiichuk, 11+ years in web and product design
- 600+ completed projects and 600+ five-star client reviews on Upwork and Fiverr Pro
- Top Rated on Upwork and a verified Fiverr Pro seller, 100% Job Success
- Platforms: Webflow, Framer, WordPress (design and build); Shopify (design); Figma for all design work
- Specialities: company websites for any industry, SaaS and fintech websites, e-commerce and Shopify design, real estate, healthcare, legal and travel websites, WordPress to Webflow migrations, landing pages, product UI and design systems, brand identity
- Every project gets a written plan with scope, timeline and a fixed price within 24 hours; no call required
- Prices (USD): website design and build from $6,900; landing page from $2,400; product UI design from $4,800; brand identity from $3,900; website migration from $2,900; UX audit $750; monthly design and development from $4,500/month; 25-hour pack $2,250
- Contact: https://sorvel.agency/contact (brief form), Telegram https://t.me/tanasiychuk8

## Services

- [AI MVP Cleanup](https://sorvel.agency/services/ai-mvp-cleanup): AI MVP cleanup: we fix, redesign and harden sites and apps built with Lovable, Bolt, v0 or Cursor, so they are fast, secure and ready for real users.
- [Brand identity design](https://sorvel.agency/services/brand-identity): Brand identity for young companies: logo, colour, type, guidelines and templates that make you look established from day one.
- [CRO Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/cro): Conversion rate optimisation for websites, landing pages and Shopify stores: research, A/B tests and design changes that turn more visitors into leads and sales.
- [Fintech Website Design](https://sorvel.agency/services/fintech-website-design): Website design for fintech, investment and financial services firms: clear products, visible trust signals and gated flows, designed in Figma and built in Webflow.
- [Framer Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/framer-agency): Framer website design and development: fast, motion-rich sites and landing pages built natively in Framer, with a CMS your team can edit. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [Landing page design and CRO](https://sorvel.agency/services/landing-pages): High-converting landing pages for ads and launches, plus monthly conversion testing. Designed in Figma and built in Webflow, Framer or WordPress.
- [Website migration services](https://sorvel.agency/services/migrations): Move your website from WordPress to Webflow or Framer, or the other way round, without losing rankings, links or content.
- [Mobile App Design Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/mobile-app-design): Mobile app UI/UX design for iOS and Android: user flows, Figma prototypes and a design system your developers can build from. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [Mobile App Development Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile app design and development for iOS and Android: cross-platform apps from first version to App Store and Google Play release. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [Next.js and Astro Development Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/nextjs-development): Custom website development in Next.js and Astro with a headless CMS: very fast pages, full control and room for complex features. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [Pitch Deck Design Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/pitch-deck-design): Pitch deck design for startups: investor and sales decks with a clear story, sharp visuals and editable files in Figma, Google Slides, Keynote or PowerPoint.
- [SaaS product and UI/UX design](https://sorvel.agency/services/product-design): UI and UX design for SaaS products, dashboards, web apps and mobile apps, with design systems your developers can build from.
- [SaaS Website Design Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/saas-website-design): SaaS website design and development: clear messaging, real product visuals and a Webflow or Framer build your marketing team can edit. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [SEO and AEO Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/seo-aeo): SEO and AEO (GEO) for websites: technical SEO, content structure and AI search visibility so you rank in Google and get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity.
- [Shopify Design and Development Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/shopify-design): Shopify store design and development: custom themes, product and collection pages built to convert, and a store your team can run. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [UX Audit Service](https://sorvel.agency/services/ux-audit): A fixed-price UX audit of your website or app: a recorded walkthrough and a written list of issues ranked by impact, with clear fixes. $750, ready in days.
- [Web App Development Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/web-app-development): Web app design and development for SaaS products, dashboards and internal tools: UX, UI and a production-ready build. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [Webflow Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/webflow-agency): Webflow design and development for SaaS, fintech and B2B: custom Figma design, clean Webflow builds, a CMS your team can edit and technical SEO. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [Website design and development](https://sorvel.agency/services/websites): Marketing websites designed in Figma and built in Webflow, Framer or WordPress for startups and growing businesses, from SaaS and fintech to e-commerce and services.
- [WordPress Development Agency](https://sorvel.agency/services/wordpress-development): Custom WordPress design and development: fast, secure sites built without bloated page builders, with an editor your team can use. Fixed quote in 24 hours.
- [WordPress to Webflow Migration](https://sorvel.agency/services/wordpress-to-webflow-migration): Move your site from WordPress to Webflow without losing rankings: content import, a 301 redirect map, meta and schema kept, and 30 days of Search Console checks.
